topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and frames complement within the broader study of immunology.

topics.label: Fundamentals, nomenclature, and central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the basic architecture, naming conventions, and central role of C3 activation in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct upstream pathways that initiate complement activation on pathogen surfaces to reach the trigger threshold.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream biological mechanisms through which complement destroys pathogens and mediates immune clearance.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory factors and mechanisms that prevent complement activation from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the distinct clinical manifestations and disease presentations resulting from deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the molecular strategies evolved by pathogens to evade complement destruction, focusing on Staphylococcus aureus.

topics.label: Lecture closing and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the lecture wrap-up and previews the upcoming session on the adaptive immune system.
